comment: display.c reset_glyphmap() (3078-3082) stores NO_COLOR for every glyph on the Rogue level unless has_rogue_color (an IBM-handling Rogue set whose nocolor is 0). roguesymset:default makes files.c read_sym_file() call clear_symsetentry(ROGUESET, TRUE), which zeroes the nocolor that init_rogue_symbols() set; the handling stays H_UNK, so the hero and the little dog are drawn without colour on Dlvl 16 and in colour again on Dlvl 1.
